name: Intro & Commercial Skipper
description: Detects recurring episode intros/outros via cross-episode audio fingerprinting, and commercial breaks via Comskip .edl import or a built-in black-frame/silence heuristic, exposing them as native skippable media segments.
overview: Fingerprints episode audio to find recurring intros/outros across a season, and imports Comskip .edl files (or runs a heuristic black-frame/silence scan) to find commercial breaks in recorded broadcast content.
changelog: 0.1.4.0: ffmpeg path now defaults to whatever ffmpeg Jellyfin itself is already configured to use (via IMediaEncoder), instead of a bare PATH lookup - no manual configuration needed in the common case, and it no longer gets lost on a reinstall. 0.1.3.0: Bumped the detection cache's format version so upgrading discards any entries written by earlier buggy builds. 0.1.2.0: Switched intro/outro fingerprinting to use ffmpeg's own Chromaprint muxer instead of a separate fpcalc binary, fixed the config page showing blank fields, and stopped caching a false 'no segments' result when ffmpeg fails to even launch. 0.1.1.0: Fixed a startup crash. 0.1.0.0: Initial release.
